summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 30 backend tests pass (incl. new Google auth invalid-session 401, real PhonePe v2 OAuth checkout URL with mercury-uat.phonepe.com, v2 webhook COMPLETED/FAILED flows). Frontend Google login button, /auth/callback route, and admin CRM dashboard all working. End-to-end booking flow confirmed to return a real PhonePe UAT checkout URL (NOT simulation fallback).
critical_code_review_comments: PhonePe v2 OAuth integration correctly caches access_token with expires_at-2min refresh window (server.py L108-146)
Webhook handler handles both v2 ({event, payload}) and legacy base64-wrapped formats and always returns 200 to prevent infinite retries - good resilience

Webhook does not verify any signature/auth - PhonePe v2 webhooks should ideally validate Authorization header username:password configured in PhonePe dashboard. Currently any caller can post a COMPLETED event with a known merchant_order_id and confirm an appointment. Consider adding webhook auth validation before going to PRODUCTION
google_auth (server.py L228-279) correctly calls EMERGENT_AUTH_SESSION_URL from env and does not hardcode URL - matches Emergent auth playbook
server.py is 833 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting payment/auth/admin routers into separate modules in a future refactor
Frontend: existing iteration_1 design issue noted that /auth route is blank (correct path is /login). Still present but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Google btn, /auth/callback, admin login + /admin dashboard all verified)
